batch: Classify three canonical works after exact duplicate reconciliation
policy: These are work-scope judgments only. They do not certify complete object extraction, endorse readings, resolve identities, adjudicate provenance claims, or change text and media rights.

entries.basis: The University of Milano-Bicocca repository abstract says the article edits, translates and comments on the inscriptions of one bowl from the Di Castro Collection.
The University of Agder repository abstract describes a measured survey of online incantation-bowl sales, illicit Iraqi antiquities, dealer provenance language and market pricing.

The Trafficking Culture project description says the chapter uses the Schøyen bowls to examine missing archaeological context, ownership history, authenticity, scholarly ethics, intellectual access and legal consequences.
